No. 03Fortune-tellingNovember 2026
Reading the stars Fortune sticks, star signs, tarot and a turtle shell from 3,000 years ago. Plus a deck you can play. 看星星的人：求籤、星座、塔羅牌，還有一片三千年前的龜甲。另外附上一副妳可以親手抽的牌。
The night before the exam考試前一晚01 / 08

You’ve done it too.妳也做過。

Plenty of people who say they don’t believe it have tried it anyway.很多嘴上說不信的人，其實都試過。

The night before a big exam, a student shakes a cup of bamboo sticks at a temple. On the train home, she reads her horoscope. In the morning, a friend pulls a tarot card for her. “Just for fun,” they all say.大考前一晚，一個學生在廟裡搖著籤筒。搭車回家的路上，她看了今天的星座運勢。隔天早上，朋友幫她抽了一張塔羅牌。「好玩而已啦。」大家都這麼說。

In a 2015 Academia Sinica survey, about three in ten adults in Taiwan said fortune-telling can predict the future. More women said so than men. In the United States, three in ten adults consult astrology, tarot cards or a fortune teller at least once a year, but only 1% say they rely on it a lot when making big decisions.2015 年中研院的一項調查裡，大約每十個台灣成年人就有三個認為算命能預知未來，女性又比男性多。在美國，每十個成年人有三個一年至少會看一次星座、抽一次塔羅或找一次算命師，但只有 1% 說做重大決定時很依賴這些。

So it’s mostly for fun. But people have been asking the sky for answers for more than 3,000 years.所以，多半是好玩。可是人類向天空要答案，已經要了三千多年。

Adults in Taiwan who believe fortune-telling can predict the future (2015)相信算命能預知未來的台灣成年人（2015 年）

Women女性36.4%
Men男性24.5%
All adults全體29.5%
Snacks for the god of exams拜文昌的零食

Before a big test, students and parents visit the god of exams, Wenchang (文昌帝君), with a copy of the admission ticket and offerings that are really puns.大考前，學生和家長會帶著准考證影本去拜文昌帝君，供品其實都是諧音梗。

  • Green onions, cong (蔥), for “clever” (聰明)蔥：聰明

  • Garlic, suan (蒜), for “good at sums” (會算)蒜：會算

  • Celery, qincai (芹菜), for “hard-working” (勤)芹菜：勤勞

  • Steamed buns and rice dumplings (包子, 粽子), for “sure to pass” (包中)包子、粽子：包中

  • Eggs, which look like a zero on a test, a “duck egg” (鴨蛋)蛋：像考零分的「鴨蛋」

  • Meatballs, wan (丸), which sound like “it’s all over” (完蛋)貢丸：「丸」音同「完」，完蛋了

  • Red turtle cakes (紅龜粿), which sound like “a total miss” (槓龜)紅龜粿：諧音「槓龜」

  • And some say Super Supau (舒跑), a sports drink, which sounds like “losing at the starting line” (輸在起跑點)有人說連舒跑也別喝：輸在起跑點

Your thoughts?

When did you last check a horoscope, draw a fortune stick or pull a card? What were you hoping to hear?妳上一次看星座運勢、抽籤或抽牌是什麼時候？當時希望聽到什麼？

Anyang, about 1200 BCE安陽，約西元前 1200 年02 / 08

Will it rain tomorrow?明天會下雨嗎？

The oldest questions people asked the sky were practical ones.人類最早向天提出的問題，都很實際。

Asking the future, from turtle shells to a government office問未來：從龜甲到政府機關
  1. Turtle shellShang dynasty, about 1250–1050 BCE龜甲・商朝，約西元前 1250–1050 年
  2. Delphi’s tripod8th–4th century BCE德爾菲的三腳鼎・西元前 8–4 世紀
  3. A star chart for the Imperial Astronomical Bureau (欽天監)until 1912欽天監的星圖・直到 1912 年
  4. “Dragon bones” in a medicine jarrecognized as writing in 1899藥罐裡的「龍骨」・1899 年被認出上面有字

More than 3,000 years ago, a diviner for a Shang king wrote a question on a turtle shell: will it rain from today until the day hsin-hai? Then he heated the shell until it cracked, and the king read the cracks. That shell is now in a museum in Nangang, Taipei.三千多年前，商王的一位占卜官在龜甲上寫下一個問題：從今天到辛亥日，會下雨嗎？接著他把龜甲燒到裂開，由商王解讀裂紋。這片龜甲現在就收藏在台北南港的一間博物館裡。

Shang kings asked about rain, harvests, hunts and childbirth. In Greece, people traveled to Delphi, where a priestess answered for the god Apollo, but only on the seventh day of the month, and never in winter. (Think your bank has short opening hours?) In Siberia, a shaman healed the sick and spoke with the spirits. In China, the Imperial Astronomical Bureau (欽天監) watched the sky and kept the calendar for the emperor until 1912.商王問的是下雨、收成、打獵和生孩子。在希臘，人們長途跋涉到德爾菲，由女祭司替阿波羅神回答問題，但只在每個月的第七天，而且冬天不開放。（還嫌銀行營業時間短嗎？）在西伯利亞，薩滿替人治病，也和神靈說話。在中國，欽天監替皇帝觀測天象、編訂曆法，一直到 1912 年。

For centuries, villagers near the old Shang capital dug up the shells, called them dragon bones and sold them as medicine. In 1899, a scholar noticed the writing on them. China’s oldest writing had nearly been ground up and eaten.好幾百年來，商朝舊都附近的村民挖出這些甲骨，叫它們「龍骨」，當成藥材賣掉。1899 年，一位學者注意到上面刻著字。中國最古老的文字，差一點就被磨成粉吃下肚了。

A forecast you could lose your head over預報不準，可能掉腦袋

Under the Yongzheng Emperor, an eclipse was read as a message from Heaven about the emperor himself. Before one eclipse, the bureau’s astronomers feared for their lives in case their prediction missed.雍正年間，日食被看成上天對皇帝本人的警示。有一次日食前，欽天監的天文官很怕預測失準，自己會性命不保。

Your thoughts?

If you could ask the sky one practical question about next week, what would it be?如果可以向天空問一個關於下星期的實際問題，妳會問什麼？

Your birthday, to the minute妳的生日，精確到分鐘03 / 08

What’s your big three?妳的三大星座是什麼？

Your star sign is only the start. Astrologers want your moon and your rising sign too, and then things get strange.太陽星座只是開始。占星師還要知道妳的月亮和上升星座，接下來就越來越奇妙了。

Sun sign太陽星座

Your core self核心的自己

Changes about once a month大約一個月換一次

Moon sign月亮星座

How you feel when nobody is watching沒人看見時的感受

Changes about every 2½ days大約兩天半換一次

Rising sign上升星座

The face you show strangers給陌生人看的那張臉

Changes about every two hours大約兩小時換一次

Ask “What’s your sign?” and most people give their sun sign: where the sun was on the day they were born. Astrologers call it your core self, the person you’re trying to be.問別人「妳是什麼星座？」，大多數人回答的是太陽星座，也就是出生那天太陽所在的星座。占星師說，它代表妳的核心自我，那個妳努力想成為的人。

Your moon sign is where the moon was. Astrologers say it shows how you feel when nobody is watching: your moods, and what makes you feel safe. The moon changes sign every two and a half days or so, so a friend born in the same week as you may have a very different moon.月亮星座是妳出生時月亮所在的位置。占星師說，它顯示沒人看見時妳的感受：妳的情緒，還有什麼能讓妳安心。月亮大約每兩天半就換一個星座，所以就算是同一週出生的朋友，月亮星座也可能差很多。

Your rising sign, or ascendant, is the sign coming up over the eastern horizon at the moment you were born. It changes about every two hours, and astrologers say it’s the face you show strangers, your first impression. So a Virgo with a Leo rising would be a careful planner who walks into the room like it’s her birthday.上升星座，是妳出生那一刻正從東方地平線升起的星座，大約每兩小時就換一次。占星師說，它是妳給陌生人看的那張臉，也就是第一印象。所以上升獅子的處女座，會是個做事仔細的計畫派，走進房間時卻像今天是她生日。

The Chinese version中式算法

The Eight Characters, or Four Pillars of Destiny (八字), write your birth moment as four pillars of two characters each; the day pillar stands for you. Purple Star astrology (紫微斗數) places stars in twelve “palaces”: money, marriage, travel and more. Tradition credits the Song dynasty sage Chen Tuan (陳摶), but the name first appears in the Ming, so the system is younger than its legend.八字把妳出生的時刻寫成四柱，每柱兩個字，其中日柱代表妳自己。紫微斗數把星曜排進十二宮，像財帛、夫妻、遷移等等。相傳它出自宋朝的陳摶，但「紫微斗數」這個名字到明朝才出現，所以它其實比傳說年輕。

What does Uranus in your third house mean?天王星在第三宮，是什麼意思？

A full birth chart splits the sky into twelve “houses”, each one a part of life. The third house covers talk, learning, brothers and sisters, and short trips. Uranus is the planet of sudden change and rebel ideas. Put them together and, astrologers say, you get a mind that thinks in lightning flashes: your texts jump from topic to topic, your siblings never know what you’ll say next, and you’re probably the one who fixes everyone’s phone.完整的星盤把天空分成十二個「宮位」，每一宮代表人生的一個面向。第三宮管說話、學習、兄弟姊妹和短程旅行。天王星是突然改變和叛逆想法的行星。占星師說，兩個放在一起，就是一顆像閃電一樣跳來跳去的腦袋：妳傳訊息老是換話題，兄弟姊妹永遠猜不到妳下一句要說什麼，而且大家的手機壞了，八成都找妳修。

Wait, what’s my real sign?等等，我真正的星座是哪個？

The Earth wobbles slowly as it spins, so the stars behind the sun on your birthday have moved about a whole sign since the dates were fixed some 2,000 years ago. And the sun also passes through a 13th constellation, Ophiuchus, the serpent bearer, from about November 29 to December 17. Astrologers say it doesn’t matter: Western signs follow the seasons, not the stars.地球自轉時會慢慢搖晃，所以從大約兩千年前定下星座日期到現在，妳生日那天太陽背後的星星，已經移了大約一整個星座。太陽還會經過第十三個星座：蛇夫座，大約在 11 月 29 日到 12 月 17 日之間。占星師說這沒關係，因為西洋星座跟著季節走，不跟著星星走。

Your thoughts?

Look up your moon and rising signs (you’ll need the hour you were born). Do they sound more like you than your sun sign? Who in your family knows your birth time?查查妳的月亮和上升星座（要知道出生的時間）。它們比太陽星座更像妳嗎？家裡誰知道妳幾點出生？

Palm up掌心朝上04 / 08

The map in your hand.手中的地圖。

Palm readers say your hand carries your story. Some of the chapters are surprising.看手相的人說，妳的手上寫著妳的故事，有些章節還挺出人意料。

Tap a line. Then hold up your own hand and compare.點一條線看看，再舉起妳自己的手比比看。

Runs under your fingers. Palm readers say it shows love and feelings.在手指下方。手相師說，它代表愛情和情感。

Crosses the middle of the palm. It’s said to show how you think.橫過手掌中間，據說代表妳怎麼思考。

Curves around the thumb. Its length says nothing about how long you’ll live. Readers look at it for big changes and moves.繞著大拇指彎下去。它的長短跟壽命無關，手相師看的是人生的大轉變和搬遷。

A second line above the heart line. Only some hands have one, and a few readers call it a “sister line”.感情線上方多出來的一條線，不是每個人都有。少數手相師叫它「姊妹線」。

The heart line and the head line join into one line straight across the palm. In the West it’s called a simian line.感情線和智慧線連成一條，橫過整個手掌。西方叫它 simian line（猿線）。

Hold up your hand. A palm reader looks first at three lines. The heart line runs under your fingers and is said to show love and feelings. The head line crosses the middle: how you think. The life line curves around your thumb.舉起妳的手。看手相的人會先看三條線。感情線在手指下方，據說代表愛情和情感。智慧線橫過手掌中間，代表妳怎麼思考。生命線則繞著大拇指彎下去。

And no, a short life line doesn’t mean a short life. Many palm readers say its length says nothing about how long you’ll live. They read it for big changes and moves.放心，生命線短不代表命短。很多手相師都說，它的長度跟妳活多久沒有關係。他們從生命線看的是人生的大轉變和搬遷。

Some hands have two heart lines, one above the other. A few readers call the second one a “sister line” and say its owner can love more than one person at the same time. Does that mean you’ll have a foot in two boats (腳踏兩條船), dating two people at once? Other readers say it just means you feel things deeply. If you have one, we suggest the second reading when you explain it to your partner.有些人的手上有兩條感情線，一上一下。少數手相師把第二條叫「姊妹線」，說擁有它的人能同時愛上不只一個人。所以妳會腳踏兩條船嗎？也有手相師說，這只代表妳感情很深。如果妳剛好有，跟另一半解釋的時候，建議採用第二種說法。

Scientists call palmistry a pseudoscience: different readers disagree, and nothing shows that its predictions come true.科學家把手相歸為偽科學：不同的手相師說法不一，也沒有證據顯示它的預言會成真。

Same line, different verdict同一條線，兩種判決

When the heart line and head line join into one line straight across the palm, Chinese palm readers call it a “broken palm” (斷掌); in the West it’s called a simian line. An old saying goes: “A man with a broken palm is worth a thousand pieces of gold; a girl with one should be raised by another family” (男兒斷掌千斤兩，女子斷掌過房養). So the same line brings a man luck and sends a girl away from home. Page 7 has a word for that kind of thinking.感情線和智慧線連成一條、橫過整個手掌時，華人手相稱為「斷掌」，西方叫它 simian line（猿線）。俗話說：「男兒斷掌千斤兩，女子斷掌過房養。」同一條線，長在男人手上是福氣，長在女孩手上，卻要把她送給別人養。這種想法叫什麼，第 7 頁有答案。

Houses have faces too房子也有面相

山mountain醫medicine命fate相appearance卜divination

In Chinese tradition, reading faces and hands belongs to xiang (相), “reading appearances”, one of the five arts (五術). Reading a house or a grave, feng shui (風水), belongs to the same family, so a feng shui master and a face reader are cousins.在華人傳統裡，看面相、手相屬於「相」，是五術之一。看房子和墳墓的風水也歸在同一類，所以風水師和面相師算是表親。

Your thoughts?

Have you ever judged someone by their face or hands before they said a word? Were you right?妳有沒有在別人開口之前，就憑長相或一雙手判斷過對方？妳猜對了嗎？

Milan, about 1440米蘭，約 1440 年05 / 08

Cards that started as games.原本只是遊戲的牌。

Tarot and Lenormand both began as games. Here’s what a few famous cards mean, right side up and upside down.塔羅牌和雷諾曼卡，一開始都是遊戲。來看看幾張有名的牌，正著放和倒過來各代表什麼。

Tap a card to turn it upside down.點一下，把牌倒過來。

Draw The Fool and a reader won’t call you foolish: it’s card zero, the start of a journey, a leap into the unknown. The Lovers is about a choice as much as romance. The Tower means everything is falling down at once, which is rarely good news. And Death, card 13? Most readers say it almost never means dying. It means an ending, so something new can start.抽到「愚人」，塔羅師不會說妳傻。它是第 0 號牌，代表旅程的起點，縱身跳進未知。「戀人」講愛情，也講選擇。「高塔」代表一切同時倒塌，很少是好消息。那第 13 號的「死神」呢？大多數塔羅師說，它幾乎從不代表真的死去。它代表一件事結束了，新的事才能開始。

Now turn a card upside down. Readers can’t agree on what a reversed card means. Some read the opposite of the upright meaning. Some read it as blocked, or as something happening inside you. Many don’t use reversals at all and just turn the card around. For a reader who sees a reversal as blocked, Death upside down might mean you’re holding on to something that’s already over.現在把牌倒過來。逆位代表什麼，塔羅師之間沒有共識。有人解讀成正位的相反；有人看成卡住了，或是發生在妳內心的事；也有很多人根本不用逆位，直接把牌轉正。對把逆位看成「卡住」的塔羅師來說，倒過來的死神可能表示：妳還緊抓著一件早就結束的事。

None of this was in the original cards. Tarot began as a card game in northern Italy in the early 1400s. In 1781, a French clergyman claimed the cards held the wisdom of ancient Egypt, with no evidence at all, and fortune tellers took it from there. The 36-card Lenormand deck began in 1799 as a German parlor game, the Game of Hope.這些意義，最早的牌上都沒有。塔羅牌在 1400 年代初是義大利北部的紙牌遊戲。1781 年，一位法國牧師宣稱這些牌藏著古埃及的智慧，完全拿不出證據，算命師卻從此接手。36 張的雷諾曼卡，則是 1799 年德國的一款客廳遊戲，叫「希望遊戲」。

Tarot塔羅牌

early 1400sa card game in northern Italy1400 年代初，義大利北部的紙牌遊戲1781the “ancient Egypt” claim1781 年，「古埃及」說法出現

Lenormand雷諾曼卡

1799the Game of Hope1799 年的「希望遊戲」about 1846fortune-telling decks under Mlle Lenormand’s name約 1846 年，以雷諾曼小姐之名出版的算命牌

Lenormand in four cards四張牌認識雷諾曼

Lenormand pictures are plain things with plain meanings: the Rider brings news, the Clover is a bit of luck, the Mice nibble away at what you have, and the Anchor is hope. (To win the Game of Hope, you had to reach card 35, the Anchor.) Our Kettlebrook deck on page 8 has a cousin of the Mice: the Hole in the Pocket.雷諾曼卡畫的都是平常的東西，意思也很直白：騎士帶來消息，幸運草是一點小運氣，老鼠會一點一點啃掉妳擁有的東西，錨代表希望。（玩「希望遊戲」時，要先走到第 35 張「錨」才算贏。）第 8 頁的凱托溪神諭卡裡，也有老鼠的遠房親戚：「口袋破洞」。

Your thoughts?

If a tradition was invented as a game, can it still help people today?一個傳統當初如果只是遊戲，今天還能幫上人的忙嗎？

At the temple在廟裡06 / 08

Ask the gods. Three times.問神明，問三次。

At a Taiwanese temple, you check the gods’ answer before you take it.在台灣的廟裡，神明給的答案要先確認過，才算數。

Moon blocks (筊杯): one throw, three answers筊杯：擲一次，三種答案

A holy yes (聖筊)

One flat side up, one round side up.聖筊（同意）：一平一凸。

A no (陰筊)

Two round sides up.陰筊（不同意）：兩個凸面朝上。

The gods are laughing (笑筊)

Two flat sides up. Ask again.笑筊（神明在笑）：兩個平面朝上，再問一次。

Drawing a fortune stick (求籤)求籤
  1. Say who you are報上姓名
  2. Shake the sticks搖籤
  3. Three yeses in a row連續三個聖筊
  4. Read the poem看籤詩

First you tell the god your name, your address and your question. Then you drop two moon blocks (筊杯). One flat side up and one round side up is a holy yes (聖筊). Two round sides up is a no (陰筊). Two flat sides up means the gods are laughing (笑筊), so ask again.先向神明報上姓名、地址和想問的事，再擲兩個筊杯。一平一凸是聖筊，表示同意。兩個凸面朝上是陰筊，表示不同意。兩個平面朝上是笑筊，表示神明在笑，再問一次。

With a yes, you shake the cup of bamboo sticks until one rises. Then you ask: is this the right stick? You need three yeses in a row before you take the poem it points to.擲到聖筊，就搖籤筒，直到有一支籤冒出來。接著再問：是這一支嗎？要連續擲出三個聖筊，才能去拿它對應的籤詩。

Taiwan has 12,598 registered temples, and many more altars and private shrines that never registered. Count them all, and there may well be more places to ask a god than to buy a tea egg: Taiwan has about 16,000 convenience stores. Temples use more than a hundred different sets of fortune poems. The I Ching works another way: toss three coins six times, build one of 64 hexagrams, then read its text.台灣有 12,598 間登記有案的寺廟，沒登記的神壇和私人宮壇還更多。全部算進來，能問神的地方說不定比能買茶葉蛋的地方還多：台灣大約有一萬六千家便利商店。各間廟用的籤詩，加起來超過一百套。易經是另一種做法：三枚硬幣擲六次，排出 64 卦中的一卦，再讀它的卦辭。

I Ching易經

Three coins, six tosses, one hexagram, built from the bottom up.三枚硬幣擲六次，由下往上排成一卦。

The odds of three yeses連續三個聖筊的機率

If each block were as likely to land one way as the other, a yes would come up one throw in two, and three in a row once in eight. (Real blocks aren’t perfectly even.)假如每個筊杯平面朝上和凸面朝上的機會一樣，平均每擲兩次會出現一次聖筊，連續三個聖筊則是八次裡有一次。（真正的筊杯並不完全對稱。）

Your thoughts?

Why do you think the ritual asks for three yeses instead of one?妳覺得，這個儀式為什麼要三個聖筊才算數？

The lab實驗室07 / 08

Does it work?準不準？

Scientists have tested astrology for decades. So why does it still feel right?科學家測試占星術已經幾十年了。那為什麼它感覺還是那麼準？

Pick your sign選妳的星座
· Your reading妳的星座解讀

You come across as confident, but you worry more than people think. You like being with friends, and you also need time alone. You have a lot of ability you haven’t used yet. Some of your plans are a little unrealistic.妳外表看起來很有自信，其實比別人以為的更常擔心。妳喜歡跟朋友在一起，也需要自己獨處的時間。妳還有不少能力沒發揮出來。妳有幾個計畫其實不太實際。

Every sign got the same words.每個星座拿到的，都是同一段話。

How accurate Forer’s students rated their sketch佛瑞的學生為那份性格描述打的準確度
012345
4.26 out of 5分（滿分 5 分）

In 1985, the physicist Shawn Carlson ran a double-blind test of astrology. Astrologers agreed beforehand that it was fair. Each one got a birth chart and three personality profiles, and had to pick the one that matched. They did no better than chance. (Some astrologers still dispute the result.)1985 年，物理學家蕭恩・卡爾森做了一場占星術的雙盲測試。參加的占星師事先都同意這個測試很公平。每位占星師拿到一張星盤和三份性格描述，要挑出相符的那一份。結果他們的命中率跟隨便亂猜差不多。（到現在仍有占星師不接受這個結果。）

Bigger studies found the same. A 2006 study of more than 15,000 people found no link between birth date and personality. A 2020 study of 173,709 people in China found none for star signs, even among believers.規模更大的研究也得到一樣的結果。2006 年一項研究調查了一萬五千多人，發現生日和性格沒有關聯。2020 年一項針對中國 173,709 人的研究，也發現星座和性格無關，就連相信星座的人也一樣。

A reading can feel accurate even when it isn’t about you. In 1948, the psychologist Bertram Forer gave 39 students a “personal” personality sketch. Every student got the same one, copied from an astrology book. They rated it 4.26 out of 5.一段解讀就算根本不是在說妳，也可能讓妳覺得超準。1948 年，心理學家伯特倫・佛瑞給 39 個學生每人一份「專屬」的性格描述。其實每個學生拿到的都一樣，是從一本占星書抄來的。學生們給它打了 4.26 分，滿分 5 分。

The Virgo problem處女座的煩惱

In China, many people stereotype Virgos as hard to get along with. The 2020 study traced the idea to the sign’s Chinese name, “the virgin sign” (處女座). In its experiments, people chose Virgos less often as dates and as job candidates, though the personality data showed Virgos were no different from anyone else.在中國，很多人對處女座有「很難相處」的刻板印象。2020 年那項研究發現，這個印象來自星座的中文名字「處女座」。在研究的實驗裡，受試者比較少選處女座當約會對象或錄取人選，但性格資料顯示，處女座跟其他人沒有兩樣。

Video · How does a fortune teller read you?影片：算命師怎麼看穿妳？

Why we ask anyway為什麼我們還是想問

During the 1991 Gulf War, Israelis living under missile attack showed more magical thinking than those who weren’t, especially people who find uncertainty hard to bear. A Taiwanese study found something similar: people who feel unsure, or who want someone to guide them, go to fortune tellers more. A reading can calm you down, give you words for a worry and help you decide.1991 年波斯灣戰爭期間，住在飛彈攻擊地區的以色列人，比沒受攻擊的人更常出現「魔法思維」，特別是很難忍受不確定感的人。台灣的一項研究也有類似的發現：覺得心裡沒底、或希望有人指點方向的人，比較常去算命。算一次命能讓妳冷靜下來，替心裡的擔心找到話說，也幫妳做決定。

Your thoughts?

Has a horoscope or a reading ever felt exactly right about you? What made it feel that way?有沒有哪一次星座運勢或算命，準到讓妳嚇一跳？是什麼讓妳有這種感覺？

Kettlebrook凱托溪鎮08 / 08

Anyone can make an oracle.人人都能做神諭。

All you need is a set of pictures, some meanings, and someone with a question.只需要一組圖、一些意義，再加上一個有事想問的人。

Sales of registered fortune-telling businesses in Taiwan, NT$ million台灣登記命理業者的銷售額（新台幣百萬元）

Only businesses registered for business tax are counted. Source: Ministry of Finance (2025).只計入辦了營業登記的業者：2019 年 75 家，2024 年 194 家。資料來源：財政部（2025）。

In 1979, a little program called fortune came with the Unix computer system. Type its name, and it prints a random saying. It was mostly a joke, but it works like many oracles: a box of answers and a random draw.1979 年，Unix 電腦系統附了一支叫 fortune 的小程式。輸入它的名字，它就隨機印出一句話。它多半只是個玩笑，運作方式卻跟很多神諭一樣：一箱答案，隨機抽出一個。

Fortune-telling is big business in Taiwan now. Registered fortune-telling businesses sold NT$287 million in 2024, five times as much as in 2019, and their number grew from 75 to 194. That’s only what the tax office can see. Scroll through Instagram or Threads and you’ll find readers selling tarot readings, crystals and more.現在，算命在台灣是門大生意。2024 年，登記有案的命理業者賣出新台幣 2.87 億元，是 2019 年的五倍，家數也從 75 家增加到 194 家。這還只是稅務單位看得到的部分。滑一下 Instagram 或 Threads，就會看到有人在賣塔羅占卜、水晶，還有各式各樣的東西。

So we made our own deck. The Kettlebrook Oracle has 36 cards, like Lenormand, drawn from InkQuest’s D&D adventure. Choose love, work, money or anything at all, then draw one card or three.所以，我們也做了一副自己的牌。凱托溪神諭卡和雷諾曼卡一樣有 36 張，畫的是 InkQuest 的 D&D 冒險故事。選感情、工作、金錢，或任何想問的事，再抽一張牌或三張牌。

The Kettlebrook Oracle凱托溪神諭卡
Your thoughts?

Did you catch yourself making the cards fit your life? That’s page 7, happening to you.妳有沒有發現，自己正在把牌義套進生活裡？第 7 頁說的事，正發生在妳身上。

Before you goLENS · 03

Things to ponder.想一想

Over a cup of tea, on your own or with someone who disagrees.泡杯茶，自己想想，或找個意見不同的人聊聊。

  1. If a reading makes you calmer and braver, does it matter whether it’s true?如果算一次命能讓妳更平靜、更有勇氣，它準不準還重要嗎？

  2. Would you date or hire someone because of their star sign, or avoid them?妳會因為一個人的星座就跟對方約會、錄取對方，或是避開對方嗎？

  3. Fortune-telling sales in Taiwan are five times what they were in 2019. What does that say about how people feel?台灣命理業的銷售額是 2019 年的五倍。這透露出大家心裡怎麼了？

  4. Which would you trust more for advice: a fortune teller, an app or a friend? Why?想聽建議的時候，妳比較相信算命師、App，還是朋友？為什麼？

How you ask changes the answer怎麼問，答案就跟著變

“…to see the future”9%
“…at least once a year”30%

The Pew Research Center asked Americans about fortune-telling twice in 2024. Asked whether they consult a fortune teller or horoscope “to see the future”, 9% said yes. Asked whether they consult astrology, tarot or a fortune teller at least once a year, 30% said yes.皮尤研究中心在 2024 年兩度問美國人算命的事。問他們會不會找算命師或看星座「來預知未來」，9% 說會。問他們一年內會不會至少看一次星座、塔羅或找一次算命師，30% 說會。
